newsitem.title: UK: Licht sees world 96/97 coffee output 95.6 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: Licht sees world 96/97 coffee output 95.6 mln bags.

text.p: German statistician F.O. Licht on Friday put world 1996/97 coffee production at 95.6 million 60-kg bags, down from its earlier forecast of 97.7 million and 1995/96's 87.7 million.
Licht said in its latest coffee report that the earlier figure of 97.7 million proved to be on the high side.
"...Our revised figure now points to a total of 95.6 million bags, up from 87.7 million bags the previous year and 95.2 million bags produced in 1994/95," it said.
"This could be short of overall demand, and this against the background of unusually low stocks," the company said.
Licht said arabica coffee production in 1996/97 is expected to total 63.05 million bags, against 58.0 million a year earlier.
Robusta output could reach 32.6 million, up from 29.7 million in 1995/96.
Licht gave no demand or stock figures.
